name: Features 1
description: 2x2 illustrated feature cards with living micro-scenes: a signing pen over a binary canvas, a cycling analytics chart, a macbook lid that opens and app icons that fly in, and a live speedometer.
interactions: 8 verbatim keyframes (prefixed wpmn-afg-): macbook lid opens 1.5s @1s delay, app icons fly in springy cubic-bezier(.87,-.41,.19,1.44) at 2/2.2/2.1s, icons wobble forever (20s), badge arrow bounces, bars bounce via --bar-index
chart: active column cycles every 2s; indicator slides translateX(63*i), height = column + 16; active bars recolor to warning/brand/dark tokens with glow
speedometer: needle retargets every 1.2s, shade rotates needle + 117.5deg, both 400ms cubic-bezier(.6,.6,0,1)
binary canvas rendered at runtime in --color-text-primary with seeded jitter
prefers-reduced-motion: all animations and intervals disabled
